$comment: Intentionally unintegrated JSON-RPC methods for desktop ↔ services contract checks. Each ignoredMethods entry needs a current technical reason. Edit by hand; run npm run service-contracts:write to refresh docs/services-api.md after services/ changes.

ignoredMethods.engine:settings-projection: Broker-to-engine-manager full settings projection for the pinned peer subscription hub. Consumed by Manager.handleSettingsMessage; the desktop consumes engine:settings-changed instead.
ignoredMethods.engine:node-projection: Broker-to-engine-manager push of this node's policy advertisement (revision, declared roles, pause origin) after every policy or availability save and on engine:ready. Consumed by Manager.applyNodeProjection and served to pinned peers as policy in /v1/models; the desktop reads it as policy on discovery nodes instead.
ignoredMethods.engine:settings-reply: Correlated broker-to-engine-manager reply to the pinned peer settings relay and the configure operation's narrow proxy rebind callback. Consumed by settingsRelay.reply, never a renderer event.
ignoredMethods.engine:settings-request: Engine-manager-to-broker correlated request for settings get/preview/apply or a validated operation's proxy rebind. Consumed by Broker.handleSettingsRelay.
ignoredMethods.engine:settings-cancel: Engine-manager-to-broker cancellation for a disconnected or revoked peer request. Consumed by Broker.forwardEngineNotification; accepted operations complete under the target's independent deadline.
ignoredMethods.engine:intent-changed: Engine-manager-to-broker push of saved On/Off engine intent. Consumed by the broker's node policy (policy.go), which mirrors it into nvpair-proxy as node/set-engine-intent so admission can refuse work for an engine saved Off. PAIR reads lifecycle from engine state, not this notification.
ignoredMethods.engine:model-identity: Engine-manager-to-broker whole snapshot of each engine it launched and owns: run id, launch digest and model content digests (docs/local-qualification.mdx). Consumed by the broker's node policy (Broker.observeModelIdentity in model_identity.go), joined with the applied-settings fingerprint and pushed to nvpair-proxy as node/set-model-identity. Never forwarded to clients; PAIR does not render strict admission identity.
ignoredMethods.policy:request: Engine-manager-to-broker correlated node-policy call (get, set, set-availability) from a pinned peer over the ec surface. Consumed by Broker.handlePolicyRelay, which re-checks the caller's pin and acts on this node only.
ignoredMethods.policy:reply: Broker-to-engine-manager correlated reply {id, result, error?, errorCode?} to a relayed node-policy call. Errors carry JSON-RPC -32602 for invalid parameters (including missing expectedPersistedRevision), -32000 for revision conflict, save or operational failure. policyRelay.reply preserves the code; inbound routes map -32602 to HTTP 400, other errors to 409; the origin maps HTTP 400 to -32602 and other HTTP failures, including 409, to -32000. Never a renderer event.
ignoredMethods.policy:cancel: Engine-manager-to-broker cancellation of a relayed node-policy call whose peer disconnected or lost its pin. Consumed by Broker.cancelPolicyRelay; an accepted availability change still completes on the target.
ignoredMethods.schedule:priority: Broker-internal. nvpair-job-scheduler emits a per-engine priority snapshot ({engine, nodes, ranks?} — ordered node ids plus each node's pending count) to nvpair-ui-broker, which forwards it to nvpair-proxy via node/set-priority; the process then layers its shared optimistic burst reservations on that baseline. PAIR consumes the routing result rather than this notification, and must not mirror the pending/reservation accounting.
ignoredMethods.engine:prepare-shutdown: Broker-owned shutdown step. nvpair-ui-broker calls it on its engine-manager during its own shutdown, after stopping the proxy so no new inference arrives. A client calling it before sending shutdown stops the engines while the proxy is still routing to them, so the desktop sends shutdown and leaves the ordering to the broker.
ignoredMethods.engine:restore-enabled: Broker-internal startup restoration. nvpair-ui-broker emits engine:restore-enabled directly to its supervised engine-manager after the managed Ollama port gate and on manager respawn; it is not a renderer/UI notification.
ignoredMethods.ollama-proxy:ready: Consumed, not missing: the broker relays it and normalizeBrokerProxy (modular-supervisor.ts) strips the `ollama-proxy:` prefix, so the bridge handles the de-prefixed `ready` (sets proxyPort). The literal `ollama-proxy:ready` is intentionally absent from our TS — extractor limitation, not a gap.
ignoredMethods.lmstudio-proxy:ready: Consumed, not missing: the LM Studio counterpart of ollama-proxy:ready, de-prefixed by the same normalizeBrokerProxy loop. It only became visible to the checker when METHOD_RE started accepting hyphens in a namespace segment; before that the whole lmstudio-proxy:* surface was silently unmatched.
ignoredMethods.llamacpp-proxy:ready: Consumed, not missing: the llama.cpp counterpart of ollama-proxy:ready, de-prefixed by the same normalizeBrokerProxy loop and mapped to the desktop llama-cpp engine identity.
ignoredMethods.node/selection-changed: Automatic routing has no selected-node UI, so PAIR deliberately does not consume proxy selection changes.
ignoredMethods.proxy/request: Per-request proxy telemetry is not rendered; workload lifecycle uses the broker workloads stream.
ignoredMethods.proxy/request-started: Per-request proxy telemetry is not rendered; see proxy/request.
ignoredMethods.workload:submitted: Producer-to-broker lifecycle event. PAIR consumes the broker's translated workloads:upsert stream rather than raw workload events.
ignoredMethods.workload:started: Proxy-to-broker lifecycle event translated by the broker into workloads:upsert, which PAIR consumes.
ignoredMethods.workload:completed: Proxy-to-broker terminal lifecycle event translated by the broker into workloads:upsert.
ignoredMethods.workload:errored: Proxy-to-broker terminal lifecycle event translated by the broker into workloads:upsert.
ignoredMethods.node/activity: Proxy-to-broker liveness evidence, consumed entirely inside the backend. Each nvpair-proxy instance raises it (coalesced to one report per node per 2s by nvpair-shared/nodeactivity) whenever a peer's engine returns inference response bytes; nvpair-ui-broker relays it to nvpair-node-scanner as discovery:node-activity, where it keeps a node that is busy serving inference from being evicted for failing a liveness probe it had no spare CPU to answer. PAIR consumes the result — the node staying in the discovery snapshot — not this per-request notification, which carries no state a UI could render. Not currently surfaced by the extractor either (it is emitted through a shared noderec constant, like nodeinfo:observed-addresses); this entry records the intent regardless.
ignoredMethods.errors:report: Producer-to-broker event demultiplexed into broker-owned nvpair-errors. PAIR consumes the resulting errors:update snapshot.
ignoredMethods.errors:clear: Producer-to-broker event demultiplexed into broker-owned nvpair-errors. PAIR consumes the resulting errors:update snapshot.
ignoredMethods.cluster:trust-changed: Broker-internal. nvpair-cluster-manager announces it from its trust store after a pin write lands, and nvpair-ui-broker answers it by calling discovery:reload-trust on nvpair-node-scanner so the scanner re-derives each peer's trusted annotation. PAIR consumes the result — the refreshed AvailableNode.trusted carried on the discovery snapshot — not this notification. It carries no payload by design: recipients re-read the cluster dir rather than trusting a diff on the wire.
ignoredMethods.cluster:set-local-services: Broker-to-cluster-manager private notification. nvpair-ui-broker sends the current authoritative local service snapshot to its supervised cluster-manager child so authenticated reverse requests can reach live local proxy ports. The desktop must not emit or consume this child-process control message; public broker requests receive method-not-found and public notifications are discarded.
ignoredMethods.cluster:peer-services: Private nvpair-cluster-manager-to-nvpair-ui-broker notification carrying an authenticated peer service claim and its admission incarnation. Consumed by Broker.relayPeerServices and relayed only to the supervised scanner as discovery:peer-services; generic client forwarding drops it. The desktop must neither emit this worker authority envelope nor consume it; it consumes the scanner's existing discovery events.
ignoredMethods.discovery:peer-services: Private nvpair-ui-broker-to-nvpair-node-scanner notification carrying the cluster-manager's authenticated peer service claim. Consumed by daemon.acceptPeerServices, which validates current admission and owns directory reconciliation. The desktop must neither emit scanner authority claims nor consume this child-process message; it consumes the resulting existing discovery snapshot and node events.
ignoredMethods.connection/cluster-auto-sync: The setting has no active backend behavior and no PAIR control, so its notification is intentionally not consumed.
ignoredMethods.cluster:invite-declined: Inviter-side-only outbound-invite terminal signal (unlike cluster:invite-expired, which the backend also emits on the receiver and PAIR consumes). PAIR's outbound pairing UI (useInvitePairing) learns the declined state by polling cluster:invite-status, and any solo cluster PAIR auto-created only to back the invite is dissolved via cluster:abandon-if-solo (the backend's own provenance-safe auto-leave also surfaces as the cluster:identity-changed + nodes:changed pushes PAIR already consumes). The receiver-side counterpart, cluster:invite-canceled, IS consumed. This push is a latency optimization PAIR does not require.
ignoredMethods.performance:received: Private nvpair-workload-manager-to-nvpair-ui-broker notification carrying an authenticated peer performance summary, its receiver-local admission identity and elapsed sample age. Consumed by Broker.consumePerformanceNotification in services/nvpair-ui-broker/performance.go; public clients use performance:get and performance:changed, never this worker message.
ignoredMethods.performance:status: Private nvpair-workload-manager-to-nvpair-ui-broker freshness status (fresh, stale, unknown) for a peer's performance summary. Consumed by Broker.consumePerformanceNotification in services/nvpair-ui-broker/performance.go; public clients use the broker projection, never this worker message.
